releaseNotes: Private accounts with sign-in and creation during onboarding, password reset and account controls in Settings.
Automatic syncing of your week, cupboard, shopping progress and My Recipes across your devices, with clear choices for conflicting edits.
My Recipes: paste a recipe link, review and save it, search your collection, edit, delete or add recipes manually.
More accurate ingredients for each cooking step, including fresh tomatoes versus tomato paste.
Plain supermarket ingredient names replace unnecessary meal-kit branding.
Consistent cooking checklists and Keep awake controls, clearer small-phone shopping layout, and phone, tablet, iOS web and offline checks.
